smoothing.selection: Previously measured first neutral mode; one requested length fixed across all profiles and resolutions; no accuracy tuning

coordinateControls.qRange: sampled on each configured solver's zReference
coordinateControls.depthBands: cap z>=-200; ramp -400<z<-200; deep z<=-400; geometric bands for nonneutral profiles
coordinateControls.calculus: interpolate physical z on the native grid, then evaluate first and second physical derivatives on common quadrature points excluding native nodes
coordinateControls.weights: absolute and relative error in native physical quadrature weights summing to the domain depth
coordinateControls.diagnosticPrefixes: candidate-only prefixes omit the reference-accuracy gate and are not certified counts
